title: Open-Meteo historical archive — Punucapa grid point, 24–27 June 2015–2025
claims: The archive request for the Punucapa coordinates returned a grid point at latitude -39.753956, longitude -73.226715, elevation 15 m.
Across 24–27 June in 2015–2025 (44 days), daily maximum temperature ranged from 7.7 °C to 14.3 °C with a median of 10.75 °C.
Across the same 44 days, daily minimum temperature ranged from -1.9 °C to 11.5 °C with a median of 5.25 °C.
32 of the 44 days had at least 1 mm of precipitation and 23 had at least 5 mm, with the largest single day at 43.6 mm on 2024-06-26.
The values are gridded reanalysis for one point, not measurements taken on the race course.

verification.checkedVia: Open-Meteo archive API JSON，每日 tmax/tmin/precipitation_sum，America/Santiago 时区
verification.note: 2026-11-08 查询。请求坐标 -39.7555 / -73.2667，API 返回网格点 -39.753956 / -73.226715、海拔 15 m。这是区域再分析网格，不是赛事数据，也不是赛道实测；同一网格点不能代表 Oncol 山顶。
